title.en: Validate a demand signal and a supply signal

goal.en: A DemandSignal says how much of an ingredient class kitchens in a region planned to use in a past week (42 sources, published 9 days after the week, no prices); a SupplySignal says a class is in glut, open to all. Validate both examples and hash the supply signal.

note.en: Validate the example DemandSignal (legume, Cairo, week of 2026-11-02). The reference hub's validate checks the document against the schema file's root; this schema keeps its kinds under $defs, so today this call reports ok for any document, and `cookwala validate` (the CLI line) is the real check.
Validate the example SupplySignal (tomato glut, Beheira, week of 2026-10-05, harvest window to 18 October).
Hash the supply signal: a signal is public, free and identical for every reader, and the hash lets any reader prove it.

outcome.en: You know the two documents a cooperative or a program publishes and why they are aggregated, delayed and price-free. The policy check is check_signal() in tools/cookwala_ref.py with vectors in conformance/profiles/signal.json. Next: 095 validates a kitchen and a production run.
